title: Studio hook form: add the `texts` row (11 locale packs) and retire its reconciliation-ledger omit
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: a follow-up owed by PR #34545 (#34374 PR1), passed on by area `o2-D`. PR1 adds a ledger omit row (`hook` / `texts`) to the metadata-form zod reconciliation root ledger and gives the reason there. This card removes that row. Dedupe: `hook.form texts`, `metadata-form reconciliation hook texts`; no open card.

reach: a named producer. Studio's hook form (`packages/spec` `hook.form.ts`) offers no row for the new `texts` key, so an author editing a hook in Studio cannot write what the schema accepts. Re-check: `grep -n "texts" packages/spec/src/**/hook.form.ts` lists nothing, and the reconciliation ledger carries the omit row.

Suggested-grade: p2 · `domain:spec` · `pm:blocked`, Blocked-by #34374

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#34374 让 hook 可以声明 `texts`(按组织语言取句子),但 Studio 的钩子编辑表单还没有这一行，在界面里写不了。PR1 先在对账账本里登记了一行「暂不提供」,并写明了原因。
- 为什么要修：能在代码里写、却不能在 Studio 里写，界面作者就用不上这个功能;账本里的豁免行也不该长期留着。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

After #34374's PR1 merges, add the `texts` row to `hook.form.ts`, with its label and help text in all 11 `metadata-forms` locale packs, and delete the `hook` / `texts` omit row from the reconciliation ledger in the same PR.

## Done when

The reconciliation gate passes with the omit row gone, and the hook form shows the `texts` row in every locale.

Blocked-by: #34374
